images.author: Daniel J. Schwarz
images.why: Classic mainland view of Mont-Saint-Michel at sunset, with warm stone, marsh foreground and a distinctive abbey silhouette.

images.author: Rino Adamo
images.why: Illuminated Mont-Saint-Michel beneath a dramatic twilight sky; 7250 × 4835 landscape photograph with substantial cropping latitude.

images.author: Dimitry B
images.why: Classic Alhambra panorama with the palace on its wooded hill and snow-covered Sierra Nevada behind; photographer explicitly identifies the spring snowfall backdrop.

images.author: Diego HG
images.why: Alhambra and Sierra Nevada in a 5314 × 4160 landscape frame; its relatively compact proportions suit a near-square crop.

images.author: Willian Justen de Vasconcellos
images.why: Sunset alternative featuring the palace above trees with Sierra Nevada behind; warmer light, though snow coverage and original dimensions are unconfirmed.

images.author: Guy Seela
images.why: 6141 × 3875 sunset landscape with richly coloured canyon cliffs and layered rock; ample crop resolution. Exact overlook is not stated.

images.author: Colon Freld
images.why: Expansive sunset view with dramatic rock formations; source explicitly identifies Grand Canyon South and tags South Rim. Exact overlook and dimensions are unconfirmed.

images.author: Parsa Mahmoudi
images.why: Grand Canyon sunset photograph with warm desert colour and receding canyon layers; Nikon D750 capture. Exact rim viewpoint is not stated.

images.author: Metin Gezer Photography
images.why: 5472 × 3648 sunrise landscape, explicitly located in Göreme, with colourful balloons above the characteristic rocky terrain.

images.author: MEHMET KAYNAR
images.why: 6000 × 4000 landscape photograph of Göreme balloons at sunrise, combining warm terrain with blue sky and generous cropping resolution.

images.author: Igor Sporynin
images.why: Balloons above Göreme Historical National Park in soft sunrise colour; photographer provides the location, capture month and Sony camera/lens details.

images.author: Mathew Schwartz
images.why: Recognisable Colosseum exterior with sunlit stone arcades and vivid blue sky; architecture dominates the composition.

images.author: Mason Pohlman
images.why: Bright daytime exterior emphasizing the Colosseum’s stacked arches against clear blue sky; strong architectural detail for a tight poster crop.

images.author: Keltoum Hyatt
images.why: Close exterior view with warm sunlight, blue sky and prominent tiers of arches; useful when the landmark should fill most of the card.
